Use-case and requirements (from notes & tech calls):
- Primary workloads: classified incident triage assistant (chat), cross-source log embeddings for fast search/reranking, automated after-action report summarization.
- Latency/throughput: service must answer operator chat < 300ms for short-turn questions, batch embedding jobs nightly for ~50M log lines. Throughput is bursty; scheduling windows ok.
- Model preferences: open/quantized LLMs acceptable, but must be verifiable offline artifacts (no blackbox hosted weights). Preferred: small-to-medium open transformer fine-tuned on ops language.
- Routing/fallback: in-air-gap fallback to smaller on-node model if KV cache miss or RAM pressure. Canary upgrades staged via isolated test VLAN.
- Data: all data stays on-prem, 7 year retention for audit records, immutable audit logging, retention controls required.

Security/compliance notes (copied from Pelorus Sec):
- "No external telemetry allowed without explicit signed MOU."
- KMS must be HSM-backed (FIPS 140-2), keys never leave hardware module.
- Full STIG checklist and ability to run automated hardening scanner required.
- SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence preferred; Pelorus will require a security assessment from their 3rd party assessor prior to deployment.

POC acceptance criteria (mutual):
- Successful offline install in Pelorus lab with no outbound network egress.
- HSM-backed key provisioning and sample encryption/decryption cycle documented.
- End-to-end example: ingest 10M log lines -> embed -> rerank results for 100 queries with <= 20% latency degradation vs baseline.
- Security: pass Pelorus automated hardening scan + provide SBOM and packaging hashes.

- Initial ARR target: $600k-$1.2M for year 1 (including install, support, and on-site training).
- Procurement windows: Pelorus finances closed until FY26-Q2; need a reseller-friendly SOW and export-control addendum.
- Potential procurement path: GSA-like schedule via integrator partner; seeking reference architecture + cost breakdown.
